👵 Visiting Grandparents - Greeting Comfortably and Helping with the Meal

🎯 Summary of core objectives:When visiting elders' homes during holidays, special education students often hide in their rooms scrolling on their phones, ignoring everyone, or even slamming doors and shouting when elders try to comfort them. The school teaches students the proper etiquette of "looking into the eyes of grandparents and greeting them loudly, serving tea with both hands, and setting the table before meals."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🍵 Fragrant oolong tea and four neatly arranged pairs of mahogany chopsticks!

The whole family drove back to their grandparents' house in the countryside for the holiday. As soon as they entered the gate, the living room was filled with uncles, aunts, cousins, and other relatives they hadn't seen in a long time. Upon seeing so many relatives, Yu's social anxiety instantly overwhelmed him. He grabbed his schoolbag and tried to rush upstairs to the living room to hide and play video games. Grandpa saw Yu, smiled, and, leaning on his cane, came over and patted Yu's head: "Yu, you've grown so tall! My dear grandson!" Yu wanted to shake off Grandpa's hand and yell, "Don't touch me! It's annoying!" But Yu remembered a story his teacher had told him—his grandparents were old and their eyesight wasn't very good, and they waited at the door every day for their grandson to come home. Yu took a deep breath, stopped, turned around, and looked tenderly into his grandfather's eyes beneath his white hair. He offered him a steaming cup of oolong tea and shouted, "Grandpa and Grandma, I'm back to see you! I wish you good health and a long life!" Then, before the meal, Yu volunteered to help in the kitchen, neatly arranging four pairs of mahogany chopsticks. Grandpa beamed, tears of emotion welling in his eyes: "Oh my! Our Yu is so sensible and filial, the best grandson in the whole family!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you stay in your room scrolling on your phone and ignore everyone when you visit your grandparents, how disappointed will they be? How much warmer will they feel if you hold a cup of tea with both hands and greet them loudly?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:A family reunion to visit grandparents. The four little heroes practice looking at the elders, greeting them, and taking the initiative to serve tea and set the table!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to hide in the room, look into the eyes of your grandparents, greet them loudly and kindly, and offer them tea with both hands.
"Good morning, grandpa and grandma!" I am Yu. I made hot oolong tea for you to drink. I wish you good health! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to break through social anxiety in cross-generational family situations and convey warm family affection.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Quickly move out the sturdiest chair with the backrest for Grandpa and help him sit down.
"Grandpa, sit down slowly!" I am Jia, I am very strong, let me carry all the heavy things! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the government to devote full energy to the entity labor service of filial piety and respect for the elderly.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Carefully arrange the red chopsticks and small spoons for the elders at the dining table, making sure they are neatly and properly arranged.
"Grandpa and grandma, please sit down. The dishes and chopsticks have been set out for you. The food cooked in the kitchen today is so delicious!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He develop meticulous and considerate qualities, and implement filial piety services in family life.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Sit next to your elders and generously share the excellent awards you received at school, making them laugh heartily.
"Look, grandma, this is my certificate from the school theater performance. I specially brought it back to you to see!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to take the initiative to enhance the emotional connection between family generations through positive achievements.

🛒 Create your own guardian while shopping at the supermarket

🛒 Shopping with Family: Stay Together and Ask Staff for Help

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Walking into a supermarket filled with a dazzling array of goods, special education children often run wildly between the shelves, secretly stuff cookies and toys into their shopping carts, or throw tantrums and cry on the floor because they didn't get their favorite snacks, and some even get lost. They are taught to "hold onto the shopping cart without letting go, choose items according to the shopping list, and if they get lost, find a uniformed store clerk."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🛒 A huge shopping cart full of items and checkmarks on the list!

On Saturday afternoon, Jun accompanied his mother to the PX Mart Welfare Center for a big shopping trip. As soon as they entered the store, Jun saw three whole rows of colorful potato chips and chocolate bars. His eyes lit up with excitement, and he grabbed three huge bags of potato chips, trying to stuff them into his mother's shopping cart! His mother sternly stopped the cart: "Jun, today we need to buy onions and tofu for dinner soup. No snacks!" Hearing this, Jun's temper flared instantly. He plopped down on the floor, hugged the cart wheel, and yelled, "I don't care! I want potato chips! I won't go home until I get them!" The aunties and uncles shopping around them all stopped and looked over. At that moment, the "Shopping Spy List" his teacher had taught him in special education class flashed through Jun's mind—children who cause trouble lose their eligibility to be the little manager! Jun took a deep breath, got up from the floor, and dusted himself off. His mother handed him a hand-drawn "Shopping List Card" and a pencil: "Jun, you're our commander!" "Find three onions for Mom in the vegetable section. If you find them all, you can choose a box of yogurt as a reward!" Jun took the list, pushed the cart, and focused on comparing the onions. He put a big checkmark on each one he found, successfully completing the task and receiving a box of his favorite strawberry yogurt!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:How embarrassing would it be if you threw a tantrum and cried on the floor at the supermarket because you weren't satisfied? Why can helping your mom find things according to the list make you a great little shopping expert?

🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu

"Hold the cart with both hands and don't let go!"I found the fresh milk on the refrigerator, the date is the latest!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to focus on specific assigned goals in a stimulus-rich store environment.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to lie down and cry, pat your pants and stand up, and carefully help your mother choose three plump onions.
"Huh ~ I shouldn't cheat on you! I am the purchasing commander, and I tick every item I find!”
💡 Tips:Guide the transfer of frustration and anger into goal-directed responsibility taking.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Gently place the fragile egg carton into the front seat of the trolley with both hands, carefully protecting the food.
"The eggs should be picked up and placed gently. If you put them on top, they won't be crushed!"”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the care and sense of accomplishment in handling daily life affairs.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Help the cashier by taking the items from the cart onto the conveyor belt in order and politely thank the cashier.
"Hello, aunt, there are seven items in total. Please help me brush the vehicle during checkout. Thank you!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to implement civilized and polite practices in real social life situations.

🌙 Goodnight Shutdown Sleep Exercise
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 6: Putian Fusion and Family Life 📌 Field:🏠 Fusion family
🎖️ Today’s badge: small model of quality sleep

💤 Bedtime Routines: Putting Books Away and Settling Down

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special education students often become so engrossed in comics or mobile games that their vestibular and nervous systems are overstimulated, leading them to refuse to go to bed until 11 p.m., creating a vicious cycle of difficulty waking up in the morning, irritability, and drowsiness in class. We teach them a 30-minute offline ritual before bedtime and deep relaxation breathing.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🌙 A little magic trick for turning off your brain's screen when the moon rises!

At 9:30 PM, the alarm clock hands had already pointed to bedtime. Mom gently opened the bedroom door and reminded him, "Yu, it's 9:30. Time to turn off the lights and go to sleep. You have school tomorrow!" But Yu was engrossed in the final chapter of his most exciting dinosaur comic, his eyes shining and his heart pounding. He couldn't bear to put it down! "I don't want to sleep! I want to read the last ten pages! Give me five more minutes!" Ten minutes passed, and Yu was still reading. Mom came over and turned off the main light. Yu immediately flew into a rage, throwing his pillow against the wall and yelling and screaming on the bed. The "magic trick" his teacher had written for him in the communication book suddenly appeared before Yu's eyes—sleep is like charging a phone; if you don't turn it off and charge it, tomorrow your phone will be a useless piece of junk! Yu took a deep breath, put the comic back on the bookshelf, snuggled into his warm bed, and placed his hands flat on his stomach: "Inhale—one, two, three, my stomach swells up like a big balloon; exhale—three, two, one, my body relaxes like sinking into soft cotton candy..." Slowly, Yu's eyelids grew heavier and heavier, and in his sweet dream, he rode a gentle thunder dragon and flew into the starry sky!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If you stay up all night reading or playing games when it's bedtime, what will happen to your brain the next day? Why does turning off the screen and books and taking deep breaths before bed help you have sweet dreams?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:It's bedtime, and the four little heroes practice resisting the temptation to stay up late and completing their pre-sleep shutdown ritual to fall asleep peacefully!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Put the comic books away on the bookshelf at 9:30 sharp, lie in bed and do deep abdominal breathing, then quietly close your eyes.
"Put the book back on the shelf, take a deep breath and exhale, your brain is about to shut down and recharge. Good night everyone!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to establish a regular sleep ritual and overcome excessive attachment to special interests.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Resist the urge to peek at the TV, turn off the main lights in the room, and lie down quietly to sleep while hugging your plush toy.
"Phew~ I have to run in physical education class tomorrow. I have slept well now so that I can be a running champion tomorrow!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to consider adequate sleep as a key self-discipline element in achieving personal exercise goals.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Drink half a cup of warm water under a soft night light, listen to gentle crystal music, relax all your muscles and fall asleep.
"Listen to the music and relax your shoulders. I learned a lot of superpowers at school today. I'm going to explore in my dreams!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He use auditory soothing techniques to overcome nighttime separation or dark anxiety.

🎬 Action:Before going to bed, organize your schoolbag and uniform for tomorrow and hang them on the back of your chair, then lie down and rest peacefully.
"My schoolbags and uniforms are all ready. I won't be in a hurry tomorrow morning. I can have a sweet dream with peace of mind!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to establish a stable and orderly psychological state for going to bed through pre-preparation.

👕 A Little Expert at Independent Living
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 6: Putian Fusion and Family Life 📌 Field:🏠 Fusion family
🎖️ Today’s badge: Little housekeeper of independent life

🧺 I Can Help at Home: Folding Clothes and Tidying Toys

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special needs children often rely excessively on their parents for chores at home. Smelly socks are left scattered in the living room, and building blocks are strewn all over the hallway, leaving parents exhausted and experiencing parental burnout. Teaching them the "clothes-folding mantra: hug to the left, hug to the right, bow upwards" helps them develop self-care skills and give back to their families.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🧺 A mountain of messy clothes and the amazing magic of folding clothes!

On Sunday afternoon, the clothes drying on the balcony were brought into the living room, creating a small mountain of clothes piled high on the sofa. Mom had just finished cooking lunch and sat down, rubbing her aching back. Usually, He would just throw his coat on the floor after taking it off and never put his toys away after playing, leaving the room looking like it had been bombed. But today, seeing his mother's tired, gray hair, He suddenly felt a pang of heartache. He remembered the "magical clothes-folding rhyme" his teacher had taught him in special education class! He ran over with a beaming smile and said, "Mom, you go rest on the sofa and have some water. I'll tame this mountain of clothes!" He took out a T-shirt, spread it flat on the coffee table, and recited the rhyme: "First step, hug with your left hand; second step, hug with your right hand; third step, put your hands together and bow upwards!" In just ten seconds, the limp shirt was folded into a neat little square! He neatly folded and sorted all the family's clothes, putting them into a basket in one go. His mother was moved to tears, hugging He tightly: "My baby has really grown up; he's Mommy's most thoughtful little helper!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:If your mom has to tidy up your clothes and toys at home, how tidy is it for her? Why is learning to fold clothes and put toys away neatly a sign of growing up?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Faced with a mountain of laundry in the living room, the four little heroes practiced the clothes-folding rhyme and demonstrated self-care skills to give back to their families!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Carefully fold your trousers in half on the table, then fold them in half again twice, and neatly place them in the wardrobe drawer.
"The pants are folded flat twice and arranged like a small building block. The drawer looks so comfortable! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to sublimate the fixed quality of neatness into excellent housework self-care ability.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Pack the LEGO bricks scattered on the living room floor into the toy box, close the lid, and push it back into the corner.
"Return the toys to their original places after playing with them!" The floor in the living room is clean, no one will step on it and get pain when walking! ”
💡 Tips:Guide the team to establish a sense of responsibility for the completion of activities from beginning to end.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:While chanting the mantra "hug left, hug right," skillfully fold all the family's clothes into neat little tofu squares.
"Hug left, hug right, bow upward!" I learned how to fold clothes, and my mother can rest for ten more minutes! ”
💡 Tips:Help He experience the sense of filial achievement of caring for parents through specific housework.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Wipe the coffee table until it's spotless, and help sort the folded clothes by family member and put them into the room.
"Put dad's in this pile, mom in that pile, everyone has clean and neat clothes to wear!" ”
💡 Tips:Guidance Jia demonstrates excellent classification and organization distribution abilities in family life.

💎 Unique Glowing Crystal
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance
🎖️ Today’s badge: Confident and shining true hero

🪞 My Unique Strengths: Three Things That Make Me Shine

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Special needs children often suffer from self-loathing and low self-esteem due to their gait, wearing thick glasses, or slow reaction time, enduring countless stares and judgments. Guiding children to stand in front of a large mirror, identify and loudly proclaim three shining qualities within themselves, helps them embrace their unique selves.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🪞 A magical dressing mirror with three golden, glowing stars!

Today, in the center of the special education classroom, a large full-length mirror with a gold frame was erected. The teacher hung a sparkling five-pointed star at the top of the mirror: "Children, in front of the mirror, let's not criticize our shortcomings. Let's embark on a magical adventure of 'discovering the shining gems'!" Four little heroes stood before the large mirror. At first, everyone was a little shy, lowering their heads, hesitant to look in the mirror. He touched his short stature and whispered, "I don't think I'm pretty enough, and I'm not fast at running..." The teacher gently took He's hand and pointed to He's clear, large eyes in the mirror: "He, look at yourself in the mirror! The first gem: You have gentle eyes that see when others are sad; the second gem: You have skillful hands that fold clothes neatly; the third gem: You have a kind heart that never laughs at others! These gems are more precious than the stars in the sky!" He looked at himself in the mirror, and his eyes slowly brightened. Yu, Jun, and Jia also stepped forward in turn, loudly proclaiming their own shining qualities! The mirror reflected four smiling faces full of confidence and strength, shining brightly in the sunlight!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:When you feel inferior to others or dislike yourself, how sad do you feel? Look in the mirror, find three of your strengths, and read them aloud. Why do they give you so much courage?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Standing in front of a large mirror, the four little heroes explore their inner treasures, practice accepting themselves, and loudly proclaim their personal shining points!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Stand tall and look directly at yourself in the mirror, with your arms hanging naturally at your sides. Read aloud three of your strengths.
"I remember the names of dinosaurs in the whole universe, I am very trustworthy, I can read quietly, I am a great Yu!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to reconstruct special education traits into personal unique talents and establish and improve self-dignity.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Pose in front of the mirror like a bodybuilder, showing off a bright and sunny smile.
"I run as fast as the wind, I am willing to protect the weak classmates, I dare to admit my mistakes and apologize, I am a brave little boy!" ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to see the awe-inspiring righteousness and courage in their own character, and strengthen the core of self-discipline.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Touching the gold glowing sticker on her chest, her eyes are gentle and bright, and she no longer shyly lowers her head.
"I am very gentle, I am good at folding clothes, I have a considerate and kind heart, and I like what I see in the mirror!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He break through the haze of inferiority, sincerely accept and appreciate the value of your own existence.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Make a big heart shape with both hands above your head, and lead everyone to applaud loudly for everyone in the mirror.
"Everyone is the only miracle in the world!"We all have superpowers to shine, and we are all the best!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to enthusiastically affirm the beauty of group diversity and ignite the fire of hope in life.

🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance

🪙 Buying Bread: Counting Money and Checking Change

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Children with learning disabilities often fail paper-and-pencil arithmetic in class, but in real life, learning to read price tags, take out the correct coin, and check change is an essential foundation for independent adult life. This course teaches practical money skills such as "reading the price tag to find the number, taking out a fifty-dollar coin, and counting change in your palm."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🥐 The fragrant pineapple bread and the clinking coins on the cash register!

Today, the special education class had an exciting "Real Money Challenge Outside of School"! The teacher gave each little hero a blue coin purse containing a fifty-dollar coin and three ten-dollar coins. The whole class held hands and went to the FamilyMart convenience store next to the school. He's task was to buy a "twenty-eight-dollar pineapple bread" for tomorrow's breakfast. Entering the store, He looked at the dazzling array of bread labels on the shelves, with so many confusing numbers. Holding the bread, He looked at the large print on the label: "28 yuan." Reaching the cashier, He's palms were sweating; he didn't know which coin to give the clerk. The teacher gently reminded him: "He, twenty-eight dollars is less than fifty dollars. Take out the big fifty-dollar gold coin and give it to the clerk!" He handed over the fifty-dollar coin with both hands, and the clerk swiped the barcode with a "beep!": "Fifty dollars taken, twenty-two dollars in change!" The clerk placed two ten-dollar coins and two one-dollar coins in He's palm. He took a deep breath and counted the money in his palm one by one: "Ten, twenty, twenty-one, twenty-two! Exactly twenty-two yuan!" He happily put the bread and receipt into his bag: "I can buy bread myself now! I'm the best little shopkeeper!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What problems might arise if you don't know how much money you need or how much change you'll receive when shopping? How does learning to count change help you become independent as you grow up?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Four little heroes practice buying bread independently at a convenience store, checking the price tag, paying cash, and counting change!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Carefully compare the price of the toast bread on the shelf to 35 yuan, and accurately take out four 10-yuan coins from your wallet to pay.
"Thirty-five yuan to get four ten yuan is just right!"My uncle would ask me for five yuan, I calculated it very clearly!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to successfully implement his number-crunching strengths into real-life trading situations.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Queue up neatly at the cashier, hand over the 100-yuan bills with both hands, and politely say thank you loudly.
"Hello, uncle, I want to buy this sandwich and give you one hundred yuan, thank you!"”
💡 Tips:Guide students to integrate polite spoken language into the routine practice of social life.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Carefully count the 22 yuan change the clerk gives you in your palm, put it into your small wallet and zip it up.
"Two ten yuan is twenty, plus two one yuan is twenty two yuan!"The change is exactly right!”
💡 Tips:Help He overcome money anxiety and build the ability to be independent in real life.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Take the initiative to help pack the noodles that the whole class bought into eco-friendly shopping bags, and remind everyone to keep their receipts.
"If you collect the invoice, you can match the prize!"Everyone successfully bought their own breakfast, a great success!”
💡 Tips:Guide Jia to take into account the environmental protection of shopping and the management of administrative details.

🚩 Raise a little yellow flag for peace of mind
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance
🎖️ Today’s badge: Traffic Safety Patrol

🚦 Crossing Safely: Wait for Green, Look Both Ways and Walk Carefully

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Children with ADHD and autism often lack awareness of road hazards, rushing across green lights and crossing blind spots of turning vehicles, which can easily lead to serious traffic accidents. Teach them three life-saving tips: "Stop at the yellow line and take a step back, look left and right when the green light is on, and hold up the small yellow flag when crossing the street."

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🦓 A little zebra on the zebra crossing and a small yellow flag held high!

After school, as they crossed the large intersection in front of OO Elementary School, a bustling thoroughfare during recess, large trucks, buses, and motorcycles roared past. Jun and his younger brother, hand in hand, prepared to cross the road. Jun saw the pedestrian crossing signal light up and immediately tried to pull his brother across! Just then, a large truck attempting a right turn sped towards them, its massive cab obstructing the driver's view! A traffic guide standing at the intersection blew her whistle: "Hurry! Danger! Back off!" She grabbed Jun's backpack! The truck, accompanied by a biting gust of wind, whistled past Jun's feet, narrowly missing them by ten centimeters! Jun's legs went weak, and he knelt on the ground, his back soaked with cold sweat. The caregiver crouched down and gently handed Jun a bright yellow "pedestrian safety warning flag": "Honey, big trucks have huge blind spots! The little green flag is lit, so you absolutely can't rush around like a wild horse! We need to stand at the edge of the crosswalk and take a big step back, look left and right to make sure the turning vehicles have completely stopped, then raise the little yellow flag high and take steady steps across the zebra crossing!" Jun took the little yellow flag, took a deep breath, held his younger brother's hand tightly, raised the flag high, looked left and right, and walked safely to the other side!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Why is it so easy to get hit by turning vehicles if you immediately duck and rush across the street when the light turns green? Why can raising a small yellow flag and looking left and right when crossing the street save your precious life?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill

🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Stand one step behind the sidewalk curb. After the green light turns on, carefully turn your head to look to the left and then to the right to make sure there are no turning vehicles.
"The little green men are on!" We looked left and right. The turning vehicles had stopped and we could leave safely! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to implement accurate visual inspection processes in daily traffic safety protection.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Hold your younger brother's hand tightly, restrain the urge to start running, and walk steadily while holding the bright yellow warning flag high.
"Huh~ I won't rush!" Raise the little yellow flag high to let the big truck driver see us, and walk to the other side safely! ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to overcome their reckless and aggressive personality and establish a sense of rigorous self-protection and care for others.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Keep your eyes straight ahead, do not use your phone or look around, and walk steadily on the central stripe of the zebra crossing.
"Walking on the zebra crossing without looking around, looking at the green light on the opposite side, stepping firmly! ”
💡 Tips:Help He maintain a high degree of concentration when crossing the road, eliminating external distractions.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Walk on the outside of the group, always keep an eye out for the movement of motorcycles turning behind you, and guide everyone to arrive safely.
"Everyone, keep the formation and don't scatter. Pay attention to the slow train on the right. Everyone will arrive at the sidewalk safely!"”
💡 Tips:Guiding Jia plays the backbone role of escort and leadership in public traffic environment.

🧼 Seven-step cleansing and refreshing wash
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance
🎖️ Today’s badge: Refreshing and tidy little gentleman

🚿 Fresh After PE: Clean Clothes, Handwashing and Personal Care

🎯 Summary of core objectives:As special education students enter puberty, they often find themselves drenched in sweat, with dripping wet hair and a strong, unpleasant odor after strenuous physical activity in physical education classes, unaware of their surroundings and causing their peers in regular classes to hold their noses and reject them. They are taught self-management of their personal hygiene, such as wiping away sweat with a towel, changing into dry underwear, and washing their hands and face.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🦁 A little lion covered in sweat and a fragrant little towel!

After playing soccer during the fourth period of PE class, Yu was drenched in sweat, his hair plastered to his forehead like a drowned rat, and the back of his gray cotton T-shirt was completely soaked, turning a deep black and emitting a strong, sour, sticky smell. The bell rang, and Yu, panting heavily, was about to walk back to his regular classroom for lunch in his soaking, smelly clothes. The classmate sitting next to him smelled it and couldn't help but pinch his nose and take a step back: "Wow! Yu, you smell awful! That sour smell is awful!" Yu froze, his face flushed red, clutching the hem of his shirt, feeling both embarrassed and ashamed. The teacher gently greeted Yu at the door: "Yu, sweating so much means you ran really hard today, you're a true hero! But after heroic exercise, you need a 'refreshing transformation'!" The teacher led Yu to the sink, showing him how to use a spare cotton towel dampened with warm water to wipe away the sticky sweat from his forehead, neck, and arms, giving him a refreshing wash of his face. He then changed into a clean, dry blue short-sleeved shirt in the changing room. When Yu emerged from his dry clothes, he looked refreshed and smelled faintly of soap. His classmates patted him on the shoulder with smiles: "Yu, you look so handsome and smell so good after changing! Let's go get some rice!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:What health and social problems might arise if you let your clothes get soaked and smelly after sweating profusely during exercise? Why does spending three minutes wiping away sweat and changing clothes after exercise make people like and want to be around you?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:After a PE class, the four little heroes, covered in sweat, practiced their refreshing transformation, changing clothes and washing their faces to maintain cleanliness!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Dry your forehead with a towel at the sink, go into the changing room to change into a dry new T-shirt, and put the wet clothes into a sealed bag.
"Wipe off the sweat and put on clean clothes. My body smells good. I feel so comfortable and energetic!"”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu to overcome body surface moisture discomfort and establish and improve independent hygiene management habits.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Wash your hands thoroughly with soap, palms and backs of hands, wipe your face clean with a handkerchief, and sit back down to prepare for your meal.
"Wash your hands before you can eat lunch!" I am not a sweaty little monster, I am a clean and handsome gentleman! ”
💡 Tips:Guide people to integrate personal image self-discipline into routine life practice.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Use a comb to tidy up your messy hair, gently pat off the dust, and maintain a dignified appearance.
"My hair is combed neatly, my face is washed, and I am happiest when I eat lunch neatly!" ”
💡 Tips:Help He develop the habit of careful self-examination of appearance to enhance personal self-esteem.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Remind all students to put their wet sportswear into plastic bags and then into their backpacks to prevent them from developing an odor.
"Wet clothes should be put into a sealed bag and zipped up. Ask your mother to wash them when you go home, so that your schoolbag will not stink! ”
💡 Tips:Guide Chia to demonstrate good life wisdom in the details of personal hygiene management.

Asking an Adult for Help When Hurt

Find a trusted adult when hurt

Yu falls and cries because his knee hurts. He stays nearby and asks the teacher for help. The teacher listens to where it hurts and follows the school’s procedure to accompany Yu to the health room. Crying does not remove the right to help. An appropriate adult handles injury care.

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:How can you get adult help if you or a classmate is hurt?

📜 Writing a Letter to a Future Hero
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance

📮 A Letter to My Future Self: Keep Learning and Keep Trying

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Looking back on the countless hardships overcome along the way, including sensory sensitivity, emotional stagnation, reading difficulties, and interpersonal friction, the students are guided to write a letter by hand (or dictate and draw a picture) and seal it in the "future time capsule," promising themselves a year from now that they will never give up.

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
✉️ A golden envelope and a time travel journey a year later!

Today in the special education classroom of OO Elementary School, the teacher brought out four "time capsule sealed tin boxes" printed with golden wings. Beautiful letter paper and colored crayons were laid out on the table. "Children, in this long journey you've taken, you've learned to hide in your shell like a turtle, to chat while throwing and catching a ball, to wipe away your tears when you fall, and to be considerate of your elders and siblings. Today, we are going to complete the most solemn task in the entire universe—to write a letter to 'yourself a year from now, when you're in a new grade!'" The four little heroes held their pens and earnestly wrote their deepest thoughts on the letter paper. Yu drew a dragon with its wings spread wide and wrote: "To Yu a year from now: I hope that by then you will dare to look into the eyes of new friends and smile, and be able to take a deep breath when you encounter something you're afraid of!" Jun wrote: "To Jun in the future: When you're angry, you must insist on counting to ten and be a reasonable hero!" He drew a big red flower: "To He in the future: Even if the words are dancing, I will slowly cut the chocolate. I'm not stupid, I'm great!" Everyone folded the letters filled with love and vows, placed them in the tin box, and clicked the golden combination lock shut. The teacher's eyes reddened, and she led everyone in a deep bow: "Children, in the future, you will be incredibly proud of your courage and perseverance today!"

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Think back on all the superpowers you've learned from the past to the present, what would you like to say to your future self? Why does sealing your vows in a time capsule give you so much motivation to move forward?
🎭 Four character situation mini theater 🦁Yu 🐻Jun 🐼He 🦊Jia full-staff drill
🎬 Today's drill scenario:Sealing a time capsule written to their future selves, four little heroes practice reviewing their growth and transformation, and making firm self-commitments!
🦁 Yu Calm and self-disciplined Yu
🎬 Action:Draw a pterosaur spreading its wings on the letter paper, and write down your expectations for future social confidence in neat handwriting.
"Hello future Yu, I hope that you in the future will have made many good friends and smile every day!”
💡 Tips:Guide Yu uses visual art combined with written vows to anchor the vision of positive self-identity.
🐻 Jun A courageous and responsible young man
🎬 Action:Draw a clenched fist on the letter paper and transform it into a big heart. Write down your vow to be a good older brother with self-discipline in your emotions.
"To the future: When you are angry, be as steady as a mountain, and never forget to step on the brake!"”
💡 Tips:Guide people to transform growth reflection into moral sentiments deeply rooted in the soul.
🐼 He Gentle and considerate little He
🎬 Action:Paste colorful little flowers all around the letter paper and write down your sincere affirmation of your perseverance and never giving up.
"To the future: You are really great. Although you are a slow learner, you take every step seriously!"”
💡 Tips:Help He experience profound self-soothing and self-efficacy improvement.
🦊 Jia Enthusiastic and rule-abiding Jia
🎬 Action:Holding the golden time-space iron box with both hands, preside over the sacred sealing ceremony with a solemn and resolute expression.
"The No. 1 space-time capsule has been sealed!"Today, one year later, we must all become better versions of ourselves!”
💡 Tips:Guiding Jia gives the learning process a noble meaning of life through the practice of ritual.

🌟 Captain of the Boat, Taking Control of Life
🏷️ Inspiration Library Topic 7: Building self-esteem and living independently 📌 Field:🌟 Self-respect and self-reliance
🎖️ Today’s badge: Almighty and independent captain

🌟 My Social Skills Journey: I Am the Captain of My Life

🎯 Summary of core objectives:Reviewing all the scenario drills in the entire 49-item lesson preparation inspiration library, the four little heroes integrated all the skills of sensory adjustment, pragmatic social skills, learning resilience, conflict resolution, environmental adaptation, and independent living, and won the highest honor, the "Life Captain Gold Medal," ready to set sail for a magnificent and wonderful life!

📖 Classroom situation adventure story island and questions Arouse empathy · Aware of challenges
🚢 A golden rudder and a great pirate ship cutting through the waves!

Today, a large, gleaming wooden "Great Wheel of Life" was erected in front of the podium in the special education classroom, surrounded by glittering badges and flags from all 101 lessons! Streamers fluttered, and a large screen displayed precious moments of Yu, He, Jia, and Jun's journey—every drop of sweat, tears, and the triumphant rise of their spirits. With tears in her eyes, the teacher stepped forward, holding four weighty "All-Round Self-Reliant Little Captain Gold Cups": "Little heroes, looking back on these forty-nine extraordinary thematic lessons, you learned how to protect your ears during alarms, how to smile when rejected, how to gently repair torn paper, and how to call for help when lost. Special education is never about making you exactly like others, but about teaching you to steer your own ship! Now, the vast ocean of life lies ahead, and each of you is a top-notch little captain holding a golden wheel!" Yu, Jun, He, and Jia stood side by side in front of the steering wheel, their four little hands tightly clasped on it, and shouted in unison: "Teacher, we have learned all the superpowers! No matter how big the storms of the future may be, we will hold our heads high and forge ahead!" The golden cannon fire resounded through the sky, and the radiant smiles of the four little heroes bloomed into an everlasting, dazzling rainbow under the clear sky of OO Elementary School!

🤔 Class discussion guidance questions:Now that you've learned so many special education life and interpersonal skills, what will you do when you encounter difficulties in life? Why do you say you are the best little captain in your own life?

💡 Tips:Guidance to completely quench excess energy and competitiveness into noble self-discipline character.

🏫 40-minute 5-step classroom teaching guide Classroom slideshow interaction
📖 Step 1 Cause Motivation · Story Island Introduction 00–08 min
🎯 Target:Through [🚢 The big golden steering wheel and the big pirate ship cutting through the waves!】Empathize with the character's situation and be aware of the real challenges and physical feelings in life.
🗣️ Guiding words:"Kids watch the big screen!"Today the protagonist encounters a big test... If it were you, how would you feel?”
💡 Step 2 Skill Demonstration · Move Dismantling 08–16 min
🎯 Target:Visually dismantle the 3-step action formula of [⭐ Little Captain’s Three Oaths to Sailing], and imprint the brain memory through body movements.
🗣️ Guiding words:"Stretch out your hands and follow the teacher: the first step...the second step...the third step, the movements are really standard!"”
🎭 Step 3 Situation Drill·Character Theater 16–26 min
🎯 Target:All members of Four Lives are on stage for a real-life simulation, and they complete positive interpersonal communication drills according to action instructions and lines.
🗣️ Guiding words:"Four superstars come on stage!" Yu, Zhen, He and Jia watched the action and lines on the big screen, Action! ”
🎮 Step 4 Interactive Game · Playground Actual Combat 26–36 min
🎯 Target:Through large-screen interactive challenges (emotion meter/breathing circle/eye radar), real-time feedback strengthens skill generalization.
🗣️ Guiding words:"The superpower actual battle begins!" Everyone took turns to go on stage to challenge the game levels, and the students in the audience cheered for a few seconds! ”
🏆 Step 5 Integration and Summary·Honorary Award Stand 36–40 min
🎯 Target:Count the honorary stars in the class, praise specific progress, hand out the original class's formula sticky notes and check in with family members.
🗣️ Guiding words:"Everyone has upgraded today!" Complete the worksheet and get it stamped. Remember to continue using this super power when you return to regular class!”

1

2

3
